title: Tinman terminal object model
description: The semantic reading of a rendered virtual screen: nested rectangles carrying roles, names and text. This is the terminal's equivalent of the browser document object model, and it is what locators bind against. Referenced by features/terminal-object-model.feature, features/tom-inference.feature and features/inspect-command.feature.

rows.description: Height of the screen the model was built from.

cols.description: Width of the screen the model was built from.

rect.description: A Ratatui-shaped rectangle in screen cells.

region.description: One node of the model. A region owns a rectangle of the screen and may split into child regions.

role.description: The semantic role the region plays on screen.

name.description: The accessible name a locator matches, such as a pane title or an item's label.

text.description: The region's rendered text, with trailing blanks removed.

selected.description: Whether the region is the currently selected or highlighted one among its siblings.
